caption: Lightning flashes over a snowy village at night, and the snow-covered roofs and street flash white for an instant.

sa.check: A snowy village at night with snow-covered roofs and a street.
The roofs and street flash white for an instant.
The houses' own lights are on.
The scene returns to dark after the flash.

pc.expect: The flash is brief: the village brightens and returns to dark; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The village stays lit for the rest of the clip; or brightens steadily; or the flash fades in slowly; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: The whole scene brightens together during the flash: the snow on roofs and street turns bright white, lit from the sky; the house lights stay steady.
pc.fail: The sky flashes while the snow stays as dim as before; or the snow lights up while the sky stays dark; or the house lights blink out at the flash; or the light sweeps across the village roof by roof.

pc.expect: The houses, roofs and street are the same across dark and lit frames.
pc.fail: Houses appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or a roof changes shape; or the street changes route; or lit windows change pattern all at once.

pc.expect: Falling snow, if any, keeps falling downward through the flash; snow on the roofs stays put.
pc.fail: Snowflakes rise or hang still; or snow slides off every roof at the flash; or flakes change direction at the flash.

pc.expect: Houses and street keep their shapes; nothing passes through anything; any bolt seen ends in the air or at the ground.
pc.fail: A house changes shape or merges with another; or a bolt passes through a house and lights it from within; or the snow turns into water; or the street becomes a river.

pc.expect: The houses' colours, the snow and the sky are consistent before and after the flash.
pc.fail: A house changes colour permanently; or the snow changes colour permanently; or the sky turns to daylight after the flash.
